secrets.name: VITE_RAPIDAPI_KEY
secrets.description: RapidAPI key for live sports data (betigolo-tips, allsports, today-football-prediction APIs). Get it from your RapidAPI dashboard. Without it the app falls back to demo data.

secrets.name: VITE_PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack public key for the premium payment flow. Get it from your Paystack dashboard. Placeholder is fine for browsing non-payment pages.
